color.gamma: Showing colour values in 0-255 gamma space
color.linear: Showing colour values in 0-1 linear space
color.recent_help: Colours you pick in any colour field appear here
help.appearance.assign: Gives the selected bodies, faces or components a colour or a material look, without changing their weight. Use it to tell parts apart or to preview a finish.
help.face.delete: Removes the selected faces and lets the neighbouring faces close the gap, or leaves the gap open as a surface. Use it to take off a rounded edge, a hole or a boss that is in the way.
help.font_details: The interface uses egui's built-in fonts (Ubuntu Light and Hack, under the Ubuntu Font Licence and the MIT/Bitstream Vera licence; Noto Emoji and the emoji icon font, under the OFL and MIT). Sketch text uses Liberation Sans (SIL OFL 1.1). The Crafting Apps' optional font pack, craft-fonts (BIZ UDPGothic, Shippori Mincho, BIZ UDMincho, Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans Arabic; SIL OFL 1.1), is not bundled in SolidCraft builds.
help.material.assign: Sets what the selected bodies are made of, such as steel, aluminium or ABS. Use it so that the mass and weight match the real part.
help.solid.draft: Tilts the selected faces by the angle you set, measured from a neutral plane. Use it on moulded or cast parts so that they slide out of the mould.
help.solid.revolve: Spins a sketch profile around an axis to make a round solid. Use it for shafts, knobs, bowls and any part that is round about a centre line.
help.solid.split_body: Cuts a body into separate bodies with a plane, the face of another body or a sketch line. Use it to make parts that are printed, machined or coloured on their own.
help.solid.split_face: Divides the selected faces along a plane, the face of another body or sketch curves, without cutting the body. Use it to give part of a face its own draft, colour or offset.
navbar.description.separator: A thin line that groups neighbouring slots.
pattern.alignment_hint: Counts include the original. Centre balances copies; Flip chooses the extra side for even totals.
prefs.max_file_size_flag: This run started with --max-file-size {size}, which applies until SolidCraft closes. These settings apply when it starts without it.
prefs.max_file_size_note: Defaults: 512 MB and 256 MB; at most 16 GB. Opening a file takes several times its size in memory. A design that keeps a large import may need a higher design file limit to save and reopen.
prefs.max_file_size_web: The web app opens STEP and import files up to 512 MB and designs up to 256 MB: a browser tab can't hold larger files. The desktop app can raise these limits.
prefs.sketch_conflict_colour_note: While a sketch's constraints conflict, the curves and points a failing constraint holds are drawn in the conflict colour too, not only its glyph or dimension. Off: they keep their usual colours.
prefs.sketch_recent_snap_note: While drawing, snap the cursor where the guides of the two most recent circle centres or straight-edge midpoints cross. Off: those guides stay visual and the cursor does not move.
prefs.sketch_state_icons_note: In History and the browser, a sketch's icon takes the colour of its state (under constrained, fully constrained or conflicting) and its tooltip names the state. Off: every sketch has the same icon.
prefs.sketch_tracking_guides_note: Temporary horizontal and vertical guides from hovered centres and edge midpoints.
prefs.status_bar_note: A thin bar along the window's bottom edge shows what is being edited, the open sketch's state in its colour and the design's units; a click on the units changes them. The sketch's state then no longer shows in the view's corner.
prefs.theme_follow_error: Not applied: {error}. The last good theme stays on.
prefs.theme_follow_launch: Followed for this run only (--theme-file); reloaded whenever another tool rewrites it.
prefs.theme_follow_note: Reloaded whenever another tool rewrites it. Choosing a theme stops following it.
prefs.theme_option_opacity_help: Adjust floating panel opacity. A readability floor protects text over viewport colours.
prefs.theme_option_tab_colours_help: Use this theme’s panel and viewport colours for each ribbon tab.
prefs.theme_option_tab_fade_ms_help: Fade panel and viewport colours when switching tabs. Zero switches instantly.
prefs.trackpad_zoom_modifier.help: Hold only this key to zoom at the pointer with vertical scroll. Off keeps the existing scroll behaviour.
render.aging_airborne_help: Airborne dust is a separate finite homogeneous scattering volume. It changes transport and raw EXR, not the surface-aging stack. Existing volume/glass/denoising restrictions remain explicit; no atmosphere is added automatically.
render.aging_empty: No aging layers: the original surfaces remain unchanged.
render.aging_help: Combine up to eight optical layers, in order. Rust and patina are authored appearances, not age/corrosion simulations. Scale is in world millimetres. No geometry, mass or engineering property is changed; glass and passive stages are excluded.
render.aging_target_help: A named target must still match its captured index and name. Global masks are world-anchored; they do not follow moving parts. This is neither cavity detection nor true edge wear. Filter the list to reach additional bodies.
render.background_completed_frozen: The displayed result is a frozen completed image. Editing a background does not repaint that result automatically. Use Regrade for camera-only changes, or Render for a new physical stage.
render.background_hdr_separate: The current HDR resources illuminate and reflect on surfaces; they are not automatically displayed as a panorama behind the subject. Changing a gradient does not rotate or recolour the lighting.
render.background_lighting_section: HDR illumination · separate from camera background
render.background_no_alpha_override: A camera background is not added to transparent output silently. Raw-master regrading uses captured coverage and does not reapply denoising; the source EXR remains unchanged.
render.background_not_light: Background colour is presentation, not an additional lighting source.
render.background_stage_occlusion: This shot includes physical stage geometry. A large floor or wall can fill the frame and hide a camera-only background. Clear or resize the stage deliberately, or change its physical reflectance. Regrading cannot remove captured geometry.
render.background_workflow: Choose the background you intend: a camera-only colour/gradient, a physical stage that receives light, or HDR illumination. They are independent. Live Preview is a modelling view; render a new image or regrade a retained master to see camera finishing.
render.bloom_help: Creative output-only glow from positive linear highlights, spread with three normalised box passes. Radius is in output pixels. Added in linear display light before sRGB; not a lens, volumetric effect or convergence improvement. The raw EXR is unchanged.
render.cpu_area_editor_help: Full side vectors in millimeters; U cross V points towards the emitting side. This differs from GPU half-edge vectors.
render.cpu_light_help: Up to eight directional lights. An empty custom list turns them off; selecting a preset restores its lights. Colours are linear RGB and intensity is relative, not watts.
render.effects_gpu_only: These effects require GPU path tracing. Changing the page never switches the renderer automatically.
render.effects_help: Combine ordered colour looks and image-space lens effects. Rendering and raw-master regrading use the same saved settings. Raw EXR stays unchanged. These are original artistic controls, not calibrated lens or branded-film emulations.
render.environment.radial_only: Centre and radius apply to Radial mode.
render.error_finish_gesture: finish the modelling gesture before previewing
render.error_finish_operation: finish the current modelling operation before entering Render
render.hdr_primaries_declared: The source declares its colour primaries.
render.hdr_primaries_undeclared: The source does not declare primaries; review the renderer colour requirements.
render.image_scene_stale: Finish the modelling gesture or refresh the scene before checking or starting an image.
render.lens_effects_help: Flare uses up to four separated bright sources in the actual linear image. Ghosts, halo, streaks, chromatic offsets and radial distortion are artistic image-space approximations. Spatial effects need opaque output; outside samples extend the image edge. Grain is deterministic. No physics, EXR or geometry is altered.
render.library_inspect_only: Select to inspect; nothing is applied automatically. Favourites and recent history belong to this open document session.
render.library_rig_help: Fit once at an explicit centre and physical extent. Complete rigs include passive cards; calibration blockers still refuse. Conservative emitter/card clearance is checked before saving.
render.library_source_preview_help: Authored base-colour source map. This is not a rendered or measured material preview.
render.light_preview_help: Live view is unshadowed; Area lights use a centre-sample approximation. Render uses the complete light model.
render.material_map_required: Choose a colour image or a normal image before using maps.
render.material_maps_help: PNG/JPEG up to 1024×1024; 16 MiB encoded total. U and V are orthogonal world-mm repeat vectors (maximum 128 repeats). Colour is sRGB; normal data uses OpenGL +Y. Files are captured at Check/Start.
render.opaque_preview_help: Opaque PBR and simple colours; blended transparency. Refraction, HDRI and final rendering are not available yet.
render.ribbon_studios_help: Browse implemented studio compositions and review their replacements before applying. Concept-only scenes remain labelled.
render.stage_panels.source_note: Authored base-colour source map. Not a measured material.
render.studio_area_help: Up to four one-sided rectangles. Orthogonal half-edges U and V define size; U × V faces the lit side. Coordinates are world-space millimetres.
render.studio_hdr_help: Radiance .hdr, 2:1 panorama, up to 2048 × 1024. EXR is unavailable. The colour assumption applies only when primaries are unspecified.
ui.3d_mouse_looks_like_cap: The reading stays put while you hold it, the way a Return to Centre device does.
ui.3d_mouse_orbit_tip: Traced: the 3D mouse turns the view around the part of the model in the middle of the view when the turn begins, marked by a faint ball. Classic: around the view's centre
ui.3d_mouse_step_pull: Pull the cap towards you, hold it, then let go.
ui.ai_mode_edits_note: Modelling commands run without asking; saving, opening, exporting and other file or destructive actions still ask.
ui.center_arc_follows_cursor_tip: A centre point arc runs clockwise or counter-clockwise the way the cursor goes round its centre. Off: always counter-clockwise from the start.
ui.colour_vision_note: Changes the colours that carry a meaning: sketch states, axes, bends, analyses and icons. If you use Windows colour filters, keep this Off.
ui.details_curvature_caption: Faces are coloured by their local radius of curvature.
ui.details_draft_caption: Faces are coloured by their angle to the pull direction.
ui.export_keymap_tip: Keys, S box favourites and the toolbar, as a file
ui.material_review.claims: Sources and licences are unverified claims. Missing values remain unknown.
ui.properties.inertia_note: About the centre of mass, in world axes (g·{unit}²)
ui.zoom_to_cursor_tip: The wheel zooms towards the point under the cursor (off: towards the view's centre)
update.prefs_flatpak: Flatpak updates this copy ({version}): run {command} or use your software centre. SolidCraft doesn't check.
